independentReadOnlyReview.review:
Read-only review of the five exact fifth-gate inputs. No Root edits or Cargo.

No actionable production defect found by source inspection in the requested
boundary. This is not an independently executed financial/source parity result.

1. Current-action source_error is populated only for the current owner.apply
   rejection when no current source observation exists. The new guard therefore
   prevents a rejected reappend inheriting an earlier StorageStopped observation.
   A genuine current StorageStopped retains its actual pending/history result,
   leaves current source_error absent and still enters NativeRecoveryRequired.
   It does not convert the recorded earlier storage error into source success.
2. last_append tracks only non-rejected AppendPending and clears on non-rejected
   ResolvePost. Pause preserves the unresolved relation. A rejected ResolvePost
   cannot clear it. Rejected reappend requires unchanged complete source fields,
   exact before==post metadata, prior verified Post==current Before, no new
   recovery/escrow, and exact original mutations. Current candidate raw object
   equals the prior actual candidate or its last linked replacement, including
   configuration, catalog, read context and physical append bindings. Every
   replacement mutation hash is checked against retained actual TLNM bytes.
3. verify_inline_operation refuses every non-null apiRejection BEFORE marking a
   historical operation append-verified or resolved, including no-write plans.
   The no-write success control computes its original unmatched-update return
   independently; rejection never supplies a source return.
4. Tests cover absent prior, changed mutation/config/observation/rejection,
   successful intervening ResolvePost, false no-publication with a real extra
   append, genuine before/post/intermediate recovery, Pause and retained original
   financial/source prefix. The source guards retain observation/rows/effects,
   not a newly supplied expected source state.

Remaining scope: these reader checks validate original physical metadata/WAL
relations, not source-authority or full cold financial reexecution. A diagnostic
alone is never a source success/capability. Independent cold-source replay must
still reproduce exact API rejection and full Before/Accepted fields. Root owns
actual Core controls; none were run in this review.
